text:
Incident Bot: ALERT: canary eu-west-12 failing healthchecks during blue->green swap — sustained 5xx spike, automated rollback triggered but DNS split appears to be 60/40 old/new. paging oncall.

alice_oncall: i'm on it, joining bridge now. paging james_sre for SRE help :rotating_light:

james_sre: on the bridge. initial graphs show error-rate jump at 12:03 UTC, latency up ~200ms, 502s from proxy layer. any recent config pushes?

maya_netops: we flipped service weights at 12:01, TTLs are 60s but some edge caches holding. seeing inconsistent answers from 3 peering POPs.

alice_oncall: confirming, canary service container logs show graceful shutdown then retries. looks like new instance image has intermittent startup race on k-v cache leading to 502s under high concurrency.

ops_bridge_bot: BRIDGE: https://zoom.company/bridge/3954321111 (recording enabled)

elena_support: field reports: two enterprise customers reported API 502s, tickets created 16234 and 16235. ETA on rollback completion? customers asking for mitigation.

james_sre: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) flip traffic back to blue fully (kill-switch), 2) disable canary feature flag, 3) invalidate edge caches for eu-west. will run step 1 unless any objections.

maya_netops: preparing DNS weight change. suggest cutover to blue-only for eu-west to remove split. pushing change to 100% blue now.

alice_oncall: executing kill-switch: POST /api/internal/flags/canary_euw12/disable -> response 200. firing traffic flip to blue-only.

alice_oncall: DNS weights change submitted: weights eu-west: blue=100, green=0. request id d3f9a. propagation in progress.

james_sre: running quick health checks against blue backend. sample curl: ```curl -i -H 'Host: api.redwood.example' https://eu-west-edge/probe``` responses are 200 now.

maya_netops: edge caches still serving some old answers. invalidating POP caches for eu-west (edge-cache-invalidate --region eu-west --pattern "/api/*"). queued jobs 42.

elena_support: updating customers: "We're seeing a transient issue during a canary rollout; we've cut back to the prior version and disabled the canary feature flag. Engineering is monitoring; will follow up." sending now.

alice_oncall: metrics trending down. 5xxs back to baseline at 12:15 UTC. latency normalizing.

james_sre: will keep canary disabled until patch rolled (race condition on kv cache). created follow-up ticket INF-7849. engineer assigned: tanya_eng.

ops_bridge_bot: NOTE: Pager duty handoff scheduled in 20m — if stable at that time, we'll hand to next oncall.

tanya_eng: taking postmortem ownership for the release bug. plan: reproduce locally, add startup lock, add integration test for k-v readiness before accepting traffic. targeting patch and canary retry tomorrow morning in low-traffic window.

alice_oncall: handoff to james_sre in 18m for ongoing monitoring. if any regression, re-open bridge and escalate to infra lead.

james_sre: acknowledged. final actions: close incident if stable for 30m post-cutover, otherwise escalate.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: customer-impacting 502s observed for ~12 minutes, mitigated by traffic flip and flag disable. tickets linked: 16234,16235. follow-up INF-7849 created.

elena_support: will keep customers updated and attach postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:

alice_oncall: closing thread here, will post postmortem draft to #postmortems once INF-7849 has investigation notes.

ops_bridge_bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (manual) at 12:40 UTC.
